_about: Historical natural-history plates used as the figure for a species, in place of the drawn study. Every entry records the artist, the work, the year of publication, the licence and the source file, so the public-domain claim can be checked. Only works published in 1928 or earlier, or works of the US federal government (public domain by statute), are used. Species with no entry here show a plain note that no public-domain portrait has been located.
